objective.question: Which first exclusive row-selection reason accounts for raw Android Doppler rows that do not reach unchanged corrected undifferenced FGO Doppler factors?
objective.allowed_result: diagnosis-no-go unless one generalizable source bug is proven by frozen-raw row identities and code

pipeline_contract.raw_row_definition: Every selected Observation row at each raw UTC epoch with its raw key retained; first-solvable report uses the epoch mapped to the unchanged FGO first epoch.
pipeline_contract.time_mapping: Retain loader integer UTC epoch key and compare it to GPST week/TOW using the existing raw-clock conversion; no reconstructed coordinate or truth is used.
pipeline_contract.fgo_factor_definition: Row key is present in unchanged FGOProblem::undifferenced_doppler_factors with corrected state enabled and receiver clock drift included.
pipeline_contract.route_aggregate: Count every selected raw row and every first-exclusive stage outcome over all selected raw epochs; report final factor count from the unchanged FGO problem.

correction_allowed_only_if: a generalizable source bug is located
the bug is demonstrated on frozen raw row identities and numerical stage counts
a separate explicit opt-in candidate and focused tests are used
production default and Phase41 behavior remain unchanged
correction_forbidden_if: evidence is only an implausible velocity or clock rate
a threshold or mask is relaxed
a coordinate or truth source is substituted
the cause is route-specific or unresolved
broadcast navigation is missing or genuinely unhealthy

execution_order: commit and push this freeze JSON
commit and push evaluator/source/tests and manifest before raw audit
run MTV-h target and record every first-solvable-epoch row with first-exclusive reason
verify UTC/GPS week/TOW row mapping and clock-jump/dt/receiver-drift stages
run the other five frozen raw routes for structural aggregate
publish immutable result and documentation; keep freeze unchanged
decision_rule: No correction or gate change is allowed unless one generalizable bug is proven by source and frozen-raw row-level numerical evidence; otherwise diagnosis is No-Go.
